description:
Stimulsoft Reports.Java is a Java based reporting tool which
		helps you create flexible and feature rich reports. All reports are
		created in a report designer with handy and user-friendly interface.
		Using Stimulsoft Reports.Java you can create reports on the basis of
		various data sources. Rendered reports can be exported to different
		formats.
